annotations.text:
Six candidates on the app's real controls — the primary button, the load stepper, the calendar week, the top-lift number and the BACK TO TODAY link.

Each card measures itself: white text on the colour, and the colour as text on the page background. 4.5 is the AA floor. The swatch at the top of every board is a live control — drop your own hex in and the numbers re-measure.

The catch with green.

#3f8a57 already means "set completed" everywhere in the app — the done rail, the tinted card, the tick.

A green accent puts "act on this" and "already finished" in the same family. Emerald sits furthest away; Forest sits closest and is the one I'd expect to actually confuse.

Going green properly means moving the done colour too — probably to a blue-grey.

Blue has no such conflict — nothing else in the app is blue since the in-progress marker moved to violet.

All three clear AA comfortably. It is a preference call between energy (Electric) and legibility (Deep).
